name: Travis Settlement
title: Window Cleaning in Travis Settlement, Spicewood | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning in Travis Settlement, 2 acre lots off TX 71. Pure water, onboard water for long drives, $10 per window, quoted by text.
intro: Travis Settlement is a Spicewood acreage subdivision off TX 71, with two acre lots, an HOA park and a private boat ramp. CleanzATX cleans windows here with pure water and brings its own tank.

sections.h2: What Travis Settlement homes are like
paragraphs: Travis Settlement is built on two acre lots, so homes sit far apart and many have long drives and wooded back yards. It has several hundred homes, priced from about $700K to $1.5M, and a Travis Settlement HOA that charges $220 to $260 a year. There is no gate. The HOA park and private boat ramp give residents lake access, which is a large part of the appeal. Vintage Estate Homes specs are common, meaning many houses share a traditional Hill Country look with stone or brick fronts, metal roofs and covered porches.
Windows are often wide and numerous, since porches and living rooms face the trees.

sections.h2: What Travis Settlement windows deal with
paragraphs: Two acre lots mean a lot of cedar and live oak around the house. Pollen from cedar in the winter and live oak in spring dust the glass, and falling leaves fill screens and tracks. Spiders move into eaves and window frames under tree cover. With lake access nearby, damp air and lake spray bring mineral spots, and irrigation over large lawns adds more hard water residue to lower windows. The tree shade also lets algae grow on lower sills, and afternoon sun shows streaks on clean glass.
Metal roofs and porch covers also drip debris onto the glass below when it rains.

No gate, so access is easy, and we carry our own 200 gallons of water on the skid, which matters on two acre lots where hose reach and well pressure vary. Water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground, so stone and brick stay free of ladders. Indoors at Travis Settlement, panes are hand squeegeed over drop cloths. Many owners here add a house soft wash, roof soft wash for algae under trees, and gutters, because leaves collect fast. Neighbors who book the same week let us run the road in one trip, which is how we keep lead time near two weeks.
A 3,200 square foot home is about $320 for exterior windows. Plan on two and a half to three and a half hours outside and about an hour and three quarters inside.

why: Onboard water supply works on two acre lots with long hose runs.
Tree shade debris and spider webs cleared from frames and screens.
Pure water handles lake spray and irrigation mineral spots.
Roof and gutter work easy to add while we are on site.

faq.q: Do you need access to my water?
faq.a: No. The skid carries 200 gallons and the pure water system runs from it, so we do not depend on your spigot or your well.

faq.q: What is the HOA situation for hiring a cleaner?
faq.a: We know of no restriction on cleaning windows. If you plan exterior wash work, check with the Travis Settlement HOA for posted guidelines.

faq.q: Can you remove lake spray and mineral spots?
faq.a: Yes. Removing hard water spots in Travis Settlement costs $10 per pane. Heavy or older spots may be etched, and we tell you what to expect before starting.

faq.q: What does a typical home in Travis Settlement cost?
faq.a: Exterior windows are about $0.10 per square foot, so a 3,200 square foot home is about $320. Cleaning inside and out in Travis Settlement is $15 per window.
Yes. Roof soft wash in Travis Settlement starts at $0.25 per square foot, $400 minimum. We use low pressure, which is the safe method for roofs.
